_comment: Implementation guides each top-level folder under au-fhir-test-data-set is validated against. Keys are folder names; values are validator -ig package references (id#version). Test data may target draft or ballot IG versions, so pin the version the data is written for, which can be a ballot or draft; never a moving build (current, dev), so results are reproducible. A folder not listed here is validated against base FHIR R4 only.
